dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: Every upstream entry carries exactly one resolution: slug, terminal plus kind, or unresolved. Unresolved means an internal report is owed, not that the asset is absent.
dependencies.edge_kind_rule: backing means solvency depends on the leg; venue means exit price does.
dependencies.coverage_note: November 3 adopts the same immutable shared reserve/concentration evidence without changing graph identity or authored 4.5 judgment. Existing whole-verification and edge-resolution limits remain; DeFiLlama claims, issuer rows and BM partial independent measurements are distinct. Source clocks and metrics are in shared_evidence.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.

coverage_basis.coverage_par_pct: reserves / token liabilities at USD1 per token; producer-calculated

shared_evidence.sfrxusd_scope: upstream frxUSD context only; no strategy/PPS/liability/redemption/authority verification
